title: Four decades of dengue epidemics in Brazil: data and code for a scoping review of serotype succession, severity and evidence gaps
description:
Data set, search log, codebook and Python scripts that reproduce the figures, tables and results of a scoping review on dengue epidemics in Brazil (1981-2026).

Contents: charting table of the 103 included studies; coded variables (federative unit, region, spatial scale, study design, epidemic period, source of serotype information); serotype-year evidence matrix; search log; PRISMA-ScR flow diagram and checklist; Figures 1-3 and Tables 1-2.
